goal: Paper trade up to $25 each market weekday in the strongest evidence-backed long-only opportunity across a curated owner-approved universe of liquid stocks, ETFs, and crypto-equity vehicles. Prefer attractive relative entry prices without abandoning diversification, risk controls, or the option to hold simulated cash when data is stale or the evidence is weak. Never place a real broker order.
owner_notes: Daily paper-trading mandate. Approved proposals update only the simulated evaluation portfolio and paper-trade audit trail; they never call Robinhood review, placement, cancel, or reconciliation tools. The active universe is a liquid, diversified subset of examples/universe.broad-equity-crypto.json sized for reliable daily collection. Native coin tickers are intentionally excluded because the market-data and policy universe is equities-only.
